## Q1 | Two Workshops

:::: {.columns gutter=1em}

::: {.column width=60%}

The Witching Hour’s profit draws one workshop back into the cauldron market. The two have the same costs, $MC = 10 + 2q$, and sell identical cauldrons into the same market, so $P = 110 - (q_W + q_O)$, where $q_W$ is The Witching Hour’s quantity and $q_O$ is the other workshop’s. The Witching Hour’s marginal revenue is $MR_W = 110 - 2q_W - q_O$. This market is symmetric.

a\) What is The Witching Hour’s best response?

::: solution

$MR_W = MC$: $110 - 2q_W - q_O = 10 + 2q_W$, so $4q_W = 100 - q_O$ and $q_W = 25 - \frac{1}{4} q_O$.

:::

b\) Graph both best responses. What is the Nash equilibrium quantity for each workshop?

::: solution

The other workshop’s best response is the mirror image, $q_O = 25 - \frac{1}{4} q_W$. The market is symmetric, so $q = 25 - \frac{1}{4} q$ and each workshop makes 20.

:::

c\) What is the Nash equilibrium price in this market?

::: solution

The market quantity is $20 + 20 = 40$, so $P = 110 - 40 = 70$.

:::

d\) Calculate each workshop’s profit if $ATC = 50$ at that quantity.

::: solution

$(70 - 50) \times 20 = 400$ coins each. Together they earn 800, less than the 850 one workshop earned alone.

:::

Now suppose the Ministry taxes every cauldron 20 coins, so marginal cost rises: $MC = 30 + 2q$.

e\) What is The Witching Hour’s new best response? Show how both best responses shift on the graph.

::: solution

$110 - 2q_W - q_O = 30 + 2q_W$, so $q_W = 20 - \frac{1}{4} q_O$. Both best responses shift in: each workshop makes less at every quantity of its rival.

:::

f\) What are the new Nash equilibrium quantity and price?

::: solution

$q = 20 - \frac{1}{4} q$, so each workshop makes 16. The market quantity is 32 and $P = 110 - 32 = 78$.

:::

g\) Calculate each workshop’s profit if $ATC = 71$ at the new quantity.

::: solution

$(78 - 71) \times 16 = 112$ coins each, down from 400.

:::

h\) How much does the price rise? Is that more or less than the tax?

::: solution

The price rises by 8, from 70 to 78: less than the 20-coin tax, but more than the 5 it rose with one workshop.

:::
